method: Same original strict heldout stint rows for all masks; observed scoring and all predicted rates aggregated to offense minus defense points per100 observed possession ends. joint includes full fitted defense residual (offline likelihood diagnostic); deployedLinear uses actual projected v4 card analytic isolated-player values, with full defense residual OFF. Neither equals engine-season net forecast. No postcut fitting, no league recalibration and no game simulation. Only three masks, not a sampling confidence interval.
